backend/main.mo: Main actor defining comprehensive education platform types (SchoolClass, Board, CourseCategory with 67+ exam types) and including authorization and blob storage mixins with migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old 9-category course system to new 67-category system, mapping legacy categories to specific new exam types.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implementation of navigation updates, competitive exams pages, school education sections, and AI learning features across frontend components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Summaries of frontend files including admin management pages, public-facing pages for courses/notes/tests, AI features, and reusable components with enum mappings.
frontend/index.css: Global styles with Tailwind directives and custom OKLCH color system defining light/dark theme variables for the educational platform UI.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for SinghGyanAcademy React application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router configuration defining all routes (home, courses, exams, school education, admin pages) with Navigation, Footer, and QueryClient providers.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Simple access denied screen component that displays a shield alert icon and message for unauthorized users attempting to access admin-only pages.
frontend/src/components/AICurrentAffairs: React component that generates mock current affairs news and quiz questions for a selected date using a calendar picker. Returns hardcoded sample data covering education, economy, environment, international relations, and science topics with associated MCQ questions.
frontend/src/components/AIExamStrategyAd: React component that generates personalized study plans for various competitive exams (UPSC, SSC, Railway, Banking, etc.). Provides mock strategy data including preparation phases, recommended books, and daily timetables after a simulated delay.
frontend/src/components/AIFeaturesShowca: React component displaying a grid of six AI learning features (AI Teacher, Notes Generator, Test Generator, Exam Strategy, Geography Expert, Current Affairs) as clickable cards that navigate to the AI learning zone.
frontend/src/components/AIGeographyExper: React component that generates detailed geography content for various categories (Physical, Human, Economic, etc.) with toggle for university vs. competitive exam level. Returns structured content with concepts, key features, visual descriptions, and related topics.
frontend/src/components/AINotesGenerator: React component that generates comprehensive study notes for different subjects (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Current Affairs) with structured content including key concepts, detailed explanations, and revision points. Includes download functionality.
frontend/src/components/AITeacherChat.ts: React chat interface component that simulates an AI teacher responding to questions about Geography, UPSC, Polity, Economy, and other competitive exam topics. Uses keyword matching to provide bilingual (English/Hindi) educational responses.
React component for generating AI-powered test questions with configurable test type, topic, and question count. Includes mock question generation logic and displays generated questions with options and explanations.
frontend/src/components/CourseCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a course category with icon, title, and course count. Maps CourseCategory enum values to human-readable labels for various competitive exams.
frontend/src/components/CurrentAffairIte: Card component that displays a current affairs update with content text and optional downloadable PDF file attachment.
frontend/src/components/FileUploadWithPr: File upload component with progress bar that converts uploaded files to ExternalBlob format and tracks upload percentage. Supports file clearing and custom accept types.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Application footer with three columns showing academy info, quick links, and social media connections. Fetches dynamic footer text from static content API.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps the application with Navigation header, main content outlet, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that toggles between login and logout states using Internet Identity. Handles authentication flow and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Main navigation header with logo, navigation links for all major sections, admin link for authorized users, and responsive mobile menu. Fetches custom logo from backend.
frontend/src/components/NotesList.tsx: Displays a grid of note cards for a specific subject with download buttons for PDF files. Shows empty state when no notes are available.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Modal dialog component that prompts authenticated users without a profile to complete registration by entering their name and email, then saves the profile and registers them as a student.
frontend/src/components/TestCard.tsx: Card component that displays test information (type, ID, question count) and provides a button to navigate to the test-taking page for a specific assessment.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeEmbed.tsx: Responsive YouTube video embed component that takes a video ID and optional title, rendering an iframe with a 16:9 aspect ratio.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance, handling authentication with Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and providing authentication status throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, courses, subjects, notes, tests, current affairs, videos, and admin functions with proper cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining the design system's color palette, spacing, and theme tokens for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutUs.tsx: Displays the About Us page with mission, vision, offerings, and founder information, fetching leadership images and static content from API hooks. Shows loading states and renders content in cards with icons.
frontend/src/pages/admin/BrandingSetting: Admin page for uploading and managing platform logo, with file preview and save functionality restricted to admin users.
frontend/src/pages/admin/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying navigation cards for managing courses, videos, notes, tests, current affairs, branding, students, leadership, and static content with counts.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageCourses.t: Admin interface for creating, editing, and deleting courses with category selection, syllabus, video lectures, and thumbnail management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageCurrentAf: Admin page for managing current affairs entries with type filtering (daily/weekly/monthly), content editing, file uploads, and delete functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageLeadershi: Admin page for managing leadership team images with CRUD operations, including image upload with progress tracking, form validation, and edit/delete dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageNotes.tsx: Admin page for managing study notes organized by subject (History, Geography, Polity, etc.) with file upload, categorization, and CRUD operations using tabs for different subjects.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageTests.tsx: Admin page for managing assessments (Daily Quiz, Weekly Test, Full Length Test) with dynamic question input fields and CRUD operations organized by assessment type tabs.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageVideos.ts: Admin page for managing video content with categories (Geography Classes, Current Affairs, etc.), YouTube link embedding, search functionality, and CRUD operations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StaticContentSe: Admin page for editing static site content including About Us description, contact information, and footer text with textarea inputs and save functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StudentManageme: Admin page component for viewing and managing registered students with search, pagination (20 per page), and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AILearningZone.tsx: Page component with tabbed interface showcasing six AI-powered learning tools: AI Teacher chat, notes generator, test generator, exam strategy advisor, geography expert, and current affairs generator.
frontend/src/pages/BankingExamDetail.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific banking exam (IBPS PO, SBI Clerk, etc.) with tabs for syllabus, previous papers, notes, and test series. Fetches courses by category and displays content with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/BankingExams.tsx: Lists all banking exam categories (IBPS PO, SBI PO, RBI Grade B, etc.) as clickable cards that navigate to individual exam detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/CivilServicesExams.ts: Displays UPSC and State PCS exam options in tabs, with UPSC sections (Prelims, Mains, Optional, etc.) and 18 state PCS exams as navigable cards.
frontend/src/pages/ClassDetail.tsx: Shows study materials for a specific class number with board selection (CBSE, ICSE, state boards) and tabs for notes, videos, question bank, and sample papers. Currently displays placeholder alerts for upcoming content.
frontend/src/pages/CompetitiveExams.tsx: Landing page for competitive exams displaying seven major categories (Civil Services, SSC, Railway, Police, Teaching, Banking, Defence) as gradient cards that navigate to category-specific pages.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying phone, email, WhatsApp community link, and office address with loading state from static content API.
frontend/src/pages/CourseDetail.tsx: Course detail page showing tabbed content (syllabus, videos, notes, test series, previous papers) for a specific course category with YouTube embeds and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/Courses.tsx: Main courses listing page displaying course cards for major competitive exam categories (UPSC, SSC, RRB, etc.) with course counts.
frontend/src/pages/CurrentAffairs.tsx: Current affairs page with tabs for daily updates, weekly PDFs, and monthly magazines, fetching and displaying items by type.
frontend/src/pages/DefenceExamDetail.tsx: Defence exam detail page showing syllabus, physical standards, notes, and test series tabs for specific defence exams (NDA, CDS, AFCAT, etc.).
frontend/src/pages/DefenceExams.tsx: Defence exams listing page displaying cards for all defence service examinations with navigation to individual exam details.
frontend/src/pages/GeographySpecial.tsx: Geography special page with tabs for different geography topics (physical, human, Indian, climatology, etc.) showing placeholder content for future articles and videos.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main landing page component displaying hero section with branding, AI features showcase, course categories, latest updates, and social media links. Fetches sorted courses by category and current affairs data to populate dynamic content sections.
frontend/src/pages/Notes.tsx: Study notes page with tabbed interface for six subjects (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Current Affairs). Fetches notes data for each subject and renders them using the NotesList component.
frontend/src/pages/PoliceExamDetail.tsx: Detail page for specific police exam types showing syllabus, previous papers, notes, and test series in tabs. Fetches course data by category and displays exam-specific content with download links.
frontend/src/pages/PoliceExams.tsx: Police exams listing page displaying cards for various state and central police examinations (UP, Bihar, MP, Delhi, etc.) with navigation to detail pages. Includes special card for SSC GD Constable linking to SSC section.
frontend/src/pages/RailwayExamDetail.tsx: Detail page for specific railway exam types with tabbed sections for syllabus, notes, previous papers, and test series. Fetches course data by category and includes YouTube video embeds for study materials.
frontend/src/pages/RailwayExams.tsx: Railway exams listing page displaying cards for RRB exams (NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, RPF, etc.) with navigation to individual exam detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/SchoolEducation.tsx: Provides a tabbed interface for school education with two views: a grid of classes 1-12 and a grid of educational boards (CBSE, ICSE, UP Board, etc.), with navigation to class-specific pages.
frontend/src/pages/SSCExamDetail.tsx: Detail page for specific SSC exam types showing syllabus, previous papers, notes, and test series in tabbed layout. Fetches course data by category and includes YouTube embeds for video content.
frontend/src/pages/SSCExams.tsx: Displays a grid of SSC exam cards (CGL, CHSL, GD, MTS, CPO, Stenographer, JE, Selection Post, Constable) that navigate to individual exam detail pages when clicked.
frontend/src/pages/StatePCSDetail.tsx: Shows detailed preparation material for a specific state PCS exam with tabs for syllabus, notes, videos, and test series, fetching course data by category and rendering YouTube embeds and downloadable resources.
frontend/src/pages/StudyMaterial.tsx: Displays subject-wise study material in a tabbed interface for nine subjects (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Maths, Reasoning, English, Hindi), fetching and rendering notes lists for each subject.
frontend/src/pages/TakeTest.tsx: Implements an interactive test-taking interface with question navigation, answer selection, progress tracking, and results display, requiring Internet Identity authentication to access.
frontend/src/pages/TeachingExamDetail.ts: Displays detailed preparation content for a specific teaching exam with tabs for syllabus, notes, test series, and paper pattern, fetching course data by category.
frontend/src/pages/TeachingExams.tsx: Shows a grid of teaching exam cards (CTET, UPTET, HTET, REET, KVS, NVS, DSSSB, etc.) that navigate to individual exam detail pages when clicked.
frontend/src/pages/TestSeries.tsx: Displays test series page with tabs for daily quizzes, weekly tests, and full-length tests, fetching and rendering test cards by assessment type.
frontend/src/pages/VideoClasses.tsx: Shows video classes page with tabs for geography, current affairs, GS, and strategy categories, displaying YouTube embeds from course video lectures.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended theme tokens for UI components (sidebar, chart, card, etc.), and animation utilities.
project_state.json: Project metadata for SinghGyanAcademy education platform defining 14 exam categories, hierarchical navigation structure, AI learning features, and implemented features for competitive exams and school education sections.
